title: 별빛 관람차 광장

generation.promptA:
Create image A for a premium cooperative spot-the-difference game.

Near the lower right stands the same original cream-colored rabbit park mascot from the earlier Wonder Park scenes, with long pink-lined ears and a teal bow tie, holding exactly one blue star-shaped balloon. generation.promptB:
